title: Spasmo
writer: Pino Boller, Massimo Franciosa, Luisa Montagnana
actors: Robert Hoffmann, Suzy Kendall, Ivan Rassimov
plot: Young couple interrupted during intimacy by disturbing discovery of a mutilated mannequin at beach ruins. Mysterious man present flees before being questioned, leaving couple unsettled and the night's events unresolved.
